description.en: A colourful WebGL2 wave pulls toward the trigger, bends the live DOM with chromatic aberration and blur, and carries one view into another.
description.zh: 彩色 WebGL2 波浪先向触发按钮蓄力内吸，随后带着实时 DOM 折射、色散、模糊与边缘光晕扫过卡片并切换视图。

keywords: 波浪 扭曲 折射 色散 模糊 视图 切换 转场 彩虹 粒子 边缘光晕 distortion waves webgl transition shader chromatic aberration libraries.dev Jakub Antalik

useCases: 转账或支付确认视图转场
彩色折射波浪切换卡片内容
discovery.caveat: 基于 MIT 协议的 distortion-waves 核心移植，支持纵向、中心环形与横向三种波型及五组色板；无 WebGL2 或开启减少动态效果时自动回退为平滑淡变。

source.implementation: MIT-licensed distortion-waves@0.1.0 WebGL2 renderer, wave front physics, particle system and DOM snapshot core adapted to a ShadowRoot-safe, iframe-free lifecycle with six native framework entries.
source.license: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Jakub Antalik. Upstream package: distortion-waves@0.1.0 (https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/tree/main/packages/distortion-waves).

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click the main action button to send the wave through the card, or click again to collapse it back. Switch between Vertical, Center and Horizontal modes and five colour palettes below.
instructions.zh: 点击卡片主按钮发射波浪切换视图，再次点击可反向收拢。下方可切换纵向、中心环形与横向三种波型及五组色板。
